steps.headline: A Context card gives OpenRouter and ChatGPT separate 250k / 1M defaults.
steps.changed: The new card sits below Default project folder. Both providers start on 250k; each can be switched independently to 1M.
steps.notice: One compact choice per provider, using the same controls as the rest of Settings. Local models are unchanged.
steps.risk: UI preview only: choices are interactive but are not saved or used by conversations yet.

steps.headline: The information button explains model limits and the cost of longer conversations.
steps.changed: The explanation covers approximate sizes, models with smaller limits, fewer summaries, and possible extra API cost or subscription usage.
steps.notice: The details stay behind a click rather than crowding the card. G-1 and G-7: shared controls and the existing information bubble.
steps.risk: This reviews the wording and layout; exact provider limits still need to be wired and tested.
